猫头鹰在树洞里闭着眼睛，准备睡觉，画面展现了它安详的睡姿和周围茂密的树叶。

page_text_ocr_zh:

嗡嗡嗡、嗡嗡嗡……
猫头鹰好想睡觉啊！
page_text_en:
Bees buzz, buzz, buzz...
Buzz, buzz, buzz...
The owl really wants to sleep!
summary_zh: 画面中，一只猫头鹰在树洞里闭着眼睛，显得困倦，而树外的蜜蜂正在嗡嗡飞舞，猫头鹰因此感到更加想睡觉。

page_text_en:
Bees buzz around, buzzing, buzzing...
Squirrels chew nuts, crunch, crunch...
Crows caw loudly, caw—caw—
Woodpeckers peck the tree hole, tap-tap-tap, tap-tap-tap...
Larks chirp shrilly, tweet-tweet, tweet-tweet...
Jaybirds cry out loudly, caw—caw—
Cuckoos call out, cuckoo—cuckoo—
Robins sing loudly, tweet—tweet—
Sparrows love to chatter, chirp-chirp, chirp-chirp...
Pigeons keep cooing, coo-coo, coo-coo...
The owl is kept awake by all the noise.

page_text_en:
It got dark,
the moon rose,

summary_zh: 夜幕降临，月亮升起，大树上的鸟儿和松鼠都安静下来，四周一片寂静，树洞里的猫头鹰终于可以安睡了。

page_text_en:

summary_zh: 夜幕下，树洞里的猫头鹰突然大叫起来，声音惊醒了树上所有正在安睡的动物。
